name: centrifugal_turbocompressor_performance
title: Centrifugal turbocompressor performance (air)
summary: Air flow rate drawn by a centrifugal turbocompressor (impeller + vaneless diffuser) at constant isentropic efficiencies: velocity triangles at the impeller outlet, Euler equation, diffuser pressure recovery; solves the nominal point and can be swept towards the maximum pressure ratio.

authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, course Machines et systèmes thermiques, repetition of 2004-10-12, exercise 2; author not identified)
origin.course: ULiège, Machines et systèmes thermiques, repetition 4 (2004-10-12), exercise 2

verification.reference: EES stored solution of thermo_models TM-0055 (MSTH_041012_exercice_2.EES, EES 7.210, full solution of all 33 stored variables at the nominal point; same equations as the imported corrigé TM-0056)
verification.notes: 24/32 comparable variables agree within 0.1 % (M_dot 0.013 %, w 0.007 %, p_2 0.003 %, v_2 0.018 %). The 8 remaining variables are the absolute enthalpies/entropies, offset by the EES-7 vs CoolProp Air reference states (+125.87 kJ/kg on h, -1814.9 J/kg-K on s, constant within 5 J/kg and 0.01 J/kg-K); all energy differences agree. No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).
